reviews.review_msg: Laura was a great, caring, and knowledgeable instructor. The materials she provided on Canvas (readings and lecture videos) were very thorough and engaging. She's a tough marker, but gives students plenty of opportunities to revise their assignments and do additional works for extra credits. I really had to work hard to get an A+ in her class.

Very supportive prof who takes time to give you feedback on your work and checkpoints for larger projects to help you track your process. Readings were a little heavy (page number wise) and you have to write weekly reading responses. If you're fine with a busier workload, I highly recommend her class!
